description:
Create a drop (a reward of items). Modes: claim (a link holders claim from), push (delivered to a recipient list when activated), award (your server awards it with iap_award, caps enforced). Audience is a rule (e.g. holders of at least X tokens). Drops start as drafts; activate with iap_set_drop_status. Store key scope: drops:write.

Params: store_id, drop ({name, mode, items: [{sku, quantity}], audience?, allowlistOnly?, maxClaims?, perWalletLimit?, startsAt?, endsAt?, description?, imageUrl?}), session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, drop: Drop} (drop.slug is the claim link id)
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_400

anyOf.description: Rule: {all:[…]}|{any:[…]}|{not:…}|{hold:{min, token?, chainId?}}|{owns:{sku, min?}}. `min` for hold is base units

mode.description: claim = a claim link; push = delivered to a recipient list; award = your server awards it

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_create_drop
title: Create a drop
